name: Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator
author: Belov

sections.description:
Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator by Belov is not just a plugin – it’s a marketing tool that works wonders in attracting users.
This plugin simplifies loan and mortgage calculations for your visitors.

Whether you’re launching a WordPress site to help others with calculations or your business is related to finance, real estate, or banking,
Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator is exactly what you need. Your clients will appreciate the convenience of calculating loan payments and mortgage terms directly on your website.
Make your service appealing and attract more potential clients!

SAVE TIME LIKE NEVER BEFORE

Numerous factors influence your financial commitments, making it challenging to calculate monthly loan or mortgage payments.
No one wants to waste time on these tedious financial calculations!
Allow your visitors to delegate this complex task to our Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator for WordPress.
Install it and transform your site into a magnet for people interested in smart financial planning.

FINANCIAL SCIENCE BEHIND THE CALCULATOR

Our calculator uses advanced financial analysis techniques to accurately calculate payments and the total cost of a loan.
The plugin supports over 170 global currencies and offers flexible payment frequency options:
annually, semi-annually, quarterly, monthly (default), bi-weekly, or weekly.
It calculates an accurate payment schedule, considering the selected payment frequency and currency.

HOW IT WORKS

Our Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator provides you with a shortcode that you can place on any page, post, or sidebar of your WordPress site.
Position it wherever you like to capture your visitors’ attention!

Outstanding Loan Balance, Interest Rate, Down Payment: It Covers Everything

Once installed, you’ll find a well-organized settings section for the calculator in your WordPress admin panel.
You can customize the date format, currency, input fields for the outstanding loan balance, interest rate, and down payment,
as well as select the payment frequency.

Increase Engagement Time

This built-in calculator is bound to become the most popular feature on your site. Visitors will find it irresistible to check their amortization schedules.

User-Friendly and Intuitive

The calculator works in real-time, displaying results instantly as users input data.
No extra buttons to click – the Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator is designed for maximum usability.

MAKE IT UNIQUE

Styling

The plugin allows you to customize the interface colors to match your website’s design.
The Pro version provides greater flexibility, offering 6 color schemes and 5 templates to choose from.

Instant Results or Email Delivery

You can choose how results are presented – directly on the form or via email.
To make this even easier, we’ve integrated with ConvertKit, HubSpot, Mailchimp, Zapier, and Make in the Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator Pro version.

PRO EDITION

Enhanced features, email marketing integration, and a revamped admin panel – make the most of the Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator!

Optimize Your Marketing

The Pro version integrates seamlessly with online marketing tools:
– ConvertKit: Collect emails, customize and send email templates, and enhance your marketing campaigns.
– HubSpot: Boost your marketing campaign efficiency.
– Mailchimp: Maximize your marketing campaign performance.
– Zapier webhook: Improve secure interactions with other services.
– Make: Automate workflows by connecting various apps and services.

More integrations are coming soon!

Additional Features

  • New intuitive admin area
  • Calculator template list
  • Customizable color schemes
  • Flexible admin notification options
  • Google reCAPTCHA version 3 integration

Translations

  • English: default, always included.
  • Your language: Coming soon!

Note: The plugin is localized/translateable by default. This is very important for all users worldwide. So please contribute your language to the plugin to make it even more useful. For translating, please use the POT file, which is always included in the plugin’s languages/ folder.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly, or upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ultimate-loan-mortgage-calculator directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Choose the Dashboard->Loan & Mortgage menu item to configure the plugin.
  4. Place the shortcode [ultimate_loan_mortgage_calculator] in your pages or posts where you want the calculator to appear.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the colors of the calculator?

Yes! You can choose from various color schemes in the plugin settings to match your website’s design.

Is it possible to set default values for the calculator?

Absolutely! You can set default values for Loan Balance, Interest Rate, and Down Payment in the plugin settings.

Does the plugin support different currencies?

Yes, you can select from a wide range of currencies to suit your needs.

Can users get the results via email?

Yes, users have the option to request detailed results sent directly to their email address.

Is there a PRO version available?

Yes, the PRO version has already been released and you can buy it on our website https://wploanmortgage.com/
